D1_no_positive_pairs.description: Q1 is a mean pairwise cosine distance over ALL sample pairs, but all 24 samples carry DISTINCT content. Every pair is a different-content pair, so the mean tends to ~1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION whether or not content exists.
D1_no_positive_pairs.consequence: The metric cannot discriminate content-bearing from content-free input. This is a metric-design defect, not a property of the gate under test.

D2_saturated_readout.description: W is drawn at scale 0.02 against VOCAB=4096, producing near-orthogonal logit vectors for any input. Both arms sit at the metric ceiling (~1.0).
D2_saturated_readout.consequence: Even a correctly-designed metric would have no dynamic range with this readout scale.

D3_readout_not_tied_to_content_definitio.description: Content was defined as the per-block slot pattern, but the synthetic readout pools over blocks with independently random per-block weights. Pooling makes the output distribution approximately permutation-invariant, so the block-shuffle control is close to a no-op in distribution.
D3_readout_not_tied_to_content_definitio.consequence: The control cannot separate because the readout was never made sensitive to the content the control destroys.

correct_interpretation: AK5_GATE_VACUOUS is NOT established. The printed verdict is an artifact of this probe. Gate power remains UNVALIDATED: unknown whether the A-K5 gate could detect content.

impact_on_ak5_verdict.reason: The corrected classification AK5_BLOCKED_DEGENERATE_TRAINING_TARGET rests on the provenance audit in evidence/ak5_provenance_correction.json (findings 1-5): random waves, random labels, salted-hash target ids, and no content-grounded wave->token head existing on this host. Those findings are independent of gate power.

correct_design_for_reuse.principle: A verdict gate needs a power check with POSITIVE pairs, not a single all-pairs mean.
requirements: positive pairs: same content, independent noise; measure within-content similarity
negative pairs: different content; measure between-content similarity
report separation between the two distributions (e.g. AUC or mean gap), not a saturated all-pairs mean
verify the control actually destroys the positive-pair similarity before trusting it as a control
confirm dynamic range: neither arm pinned at a metric ceiling or floor

process_lessons.lesson_1: A gate-power check must itself be validated. A probe that cannot pass on a KNOWN-positive input cannot certify or condemn the gate it tests.
process_lessons.lesson_2: Saturated metrics (both arms at ceiling) are a probe defect signal. Check dynamic range before reading any delta.
process_lessons.lesson_3: Reporting a probe's verdict without checking the probe's own validity would have propagated a false conclusion into the contract.
